comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified:** the [earlier finding](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13000#issuecomment-5790940598) about an empty `unreal.json` is resolved at `9a2c267`, as described in the [author's reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13000#issuecomment-5799605698). No regressions were found in the changed helper or its test.

Same starting point in each case: a previous valid `Omarchy.json`, then the helper runs with the input shown.

| `unreal.json` input | `6098712` (previously reviewed) | `9a2c267` (current) |
|---|---|---|
| zero bytes | exit 0, `Omarchy.json` emptied | exit 1, previous file kept byte for byte |
| whitespace only | exit 0, `Omarchy.json` emptied | exit 1, previous file kept |
| valid theme | exit 0, theme written | exit 0, byte-identical theme |

- `jq -e` exits 4 when the file contains no JSON document. The existing failure branch then removes the temporary file and reports `unreal.json ... is empty or has an invalid color`.
- The new zero-byte case in `test/shell.d/unreal-theme-test.sh` fails against the previous helper and passes on the current head.
- The only caller, `bin/omarchy-theme-set`, runs the helper in the background and does not act on its exit status. The new nonzero exit therefore prints the error line without interrupting the theme switch, the same way an invalid color already did.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source inspection of the new commit, jq's `--exit-status` handling and the helper's caller. Isolated runs of the helper and the Unreal theme test on both revisions used jq 1.8.2. Other jq releases were checked from source only. No native Unreal editor testing was done.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments of this follow-up, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
